title: BlockRegistry
description: Machine-readable list of every ContentBlock in a document family. block_id pattern ^[a-z0-9_]{3,64}$ is the canonical identifier used in master template markers. (scope plan §4.2 ContentBlock, NF-04)

family_key.description: Document family this registry belongs to.

blocks.description: All ContentBlock entries for this family.

block_id.description: Unique within family; appears verbatim in [[BLOCK:block_id]] markers in the master.

kind.description: Structural kind of the block. (scope plan §4.2 ContentBlock.kind)

optional.description: false = always retained in the output regardless of recipe rules.

status.description: Lifecycle state. A block cannot be 'removed' while any published recipe references it. (scope plan §4.3 ContentBlock lifecycle)

source_ref.description: Optional: which legacy SourceTemplate this block was decomposed from (provenance, AD-05).

owner.description: Optional: member ID of the Content Curator accountable for this block (R-03).
